Report and news

Today’s report

21 November 2026 – 10H 19 MIN

Yes, we’ve already had snow in October (a few flakes) and November (several centimeters, actually)! You can see photos and videos here: WINTER SEASON 2026-2027 | Flickr

But we’ll have to wait for a few more snowfalls before we open! 😉

Subscribe to the Mont SUTTON newsletter so you don’t miss a thing about the opening.

Here are a few highlights from the season to tide you over: Best Moments of the 2025–2026 Season | Flickr

We look forward to being on the slopes together again!

By: Mont SUTTON at 10:19
